- [S1] Atlas design study for this topic (docs/30-forces-content-spec.md §2–§4 and §9): a generic school science bench, not a specific product. DESIGN: bench 1.80 × 0.70 m, 75 cm high; ramp 42 cm at 14°, release heights 3, 6 and 9 cm above a wooden runway 1.30 × 0.28 m; toy car 9 cm long on 22 mm wheels; friction board 60 × 24 cm with glass, wood and sandpaper lanes; wooden block 10 × 6 × 4 cm, 200 g, two 200 g brass weights; spring balances 0–10 N, 1 cm of stretch per newton; test spring 8.0 cm long, 50 g hanger and seven 50 g slotted masses; drop tower 1.6 m with drop heights 0.5, 1.0 and 1.5 m over sand; steel balls 19 and 38 mm across (28 g and 224 g); A4 sheets of 5 g, one crumpled into a ball 5 cm across; a 16-inch bicycle wheel on a stand with a rim brake; sponge 10 × 7 × 4 cm under a 200 g weight. SIM (model g = 9.8 N per kg): push from behind / front / hard front / side on a car rolling at 0.6 m/s: 0.9 / 0.3 / 0 / 0.60 m/s (the side push turns it 15°); from rest, a push from behind 0.3 m/s, the magnet 0.4 m/s. Fall of 1.0 m: steel balls 0.45 s each, crumpled paper 0.46 s, flat paper 1.00 s (0.5 m: 0.32, 0.32, 0.54 s; 1.5 m: 0.55, 0.57, 1.47 s); flat paper settles at about 1.1 m/s. Weights: small ball 0.3 N, big ball 2.2 N, paper 0.05 N (reads 0.0 N). Block, start / keep sliding: glass 0.5 / 0.4 N, wood 1.0 / 0.6 N, sandpaper 1.8 / 1.4 N; on wood with 200 g and 400 g added: 2.0 / 1.2 N and 2.9 / 1.8 N. Car from 3 / 6 / 9 cm: glass 40 / 80 / 120 cm, wood 27 / 53 / 80 cm, carpet 10 / 19 / 29 cm. Spring: 1.0 cm per 50 g up to 300 g; 350 g 7.3 cm, 400 g 9.2 cm; after unloading 0.4 cm and 1.2 cm longer. Brake wheel from 2 turns per second: not squeezed 80.4 s and 80.4 turns, light squeeze 1.8 s and 1.8 turns, firm squeeze 0.6 s and 0.6 turns. / 本主题的 Atlas 设计研究（docs/30-forces-content-spec.md §2–§4、§9）：通用的学校科学实验台，不代表任何具体产品。设计值：实验台 1.80 × 0.70 m，高 75 cm；斜面长 42 cm、坡度 14°，释放高度比木跑道高 3、6、9 cm，跑道 1.30 × 0.28 m；玩具车长 9 cm，车轮直径 22 mm；摩擦板 60 × 24 cm，有玻璃、木、砂纸三条道；木块 10 × 6 × 4 cm、200 g，另有两只 200 g 黄铜砝码；弹簧秤 0–10 N，每牛顿伸长 1 cm；实验弹簧原长 8.0 cm，50 g 挂钩和七片 50 g 槽码；落体架高 1.6 m，下落高度 0.5、1.0、1.5 m，下面是沙盘；钢球直径 19 mm 和 38 mm（28 g 和 224 g）；A4 纸每张 5 g，一张揉成直径 5 cm 的纸团；架子上的一只 16 英寸自行车轮，带轮圈刹车；10 × 7 × 4 cm 的海绵，压着 200 g 的砝码。模拟值（模型取 g = 每千克 9.8 N）：小车以 0.6 m/s 滚动时，从后推、从前推、从前用力推、从侧面推，推后速度分别为 0.9、0.3、0、0.60 m/s（侧推让它偏转 15°）；静止时从后推得 0.3 m/s，磁铁推得 0.4 m/s。下落 1.0 m：两只钢球各约 0.45 s，纸团 0.46 s，摊平的纸 1.00 s（0.5 m：0.32、0.32、0.54 s；1.5 m：0.55、0.57、1.47 s）；摊平的纸最后以约 1.1 m/s 匀速下落。重量：小钢球 0.3 N，大钢球 2.2 N，一张纸 0.05 N（秤上读 0.0 N）。木块开始滑动 / 保持滑动的拉力：玻璃 0.5 / 0.4 N，木 1.0 / 0.6 N，砂纸 1.8 / 1.4 N；木面道上加 200 g、400 g 砝码：2.0 / 1.2 N、2.9 / 1.8 N。小车从 3、6、9 cm 高处出发：玻璃 40、80、120 cm，木 27、53、80 cm，地毯 10、19、29 cm。弹簧：300 g 以内每 50 g 伸长 1.0 cm；350 g 伸长 7.3 cm，400 g 伸长 9.2 cm；取下后分别比原来长 0.4 cm、1.2 cm。刹车轮起转每秒 2 圈：不捏 80.4 s、80.4 圈，轻捏 1.8 s、1.8 圈，用力捏 0.6 s、0.6 圈。 (Not a measurement. Six small deterministic models, one per experiment, give the SIM readings; each is worked out in full precision and rounded only for display. Push: a velocity change at the push point, then slowing at 0.06 g on glass. Fall: dv/dt = g − (½ ρ C A ÷ m) v² stepped every millisecond with ρ = 1.21 kg/m³, C = 0.45 for the balls [S6], 1.12 for the flat sheet (the circular-plate value, illustrative) and 0.6 for the crumpled sheet (illustrative); areas from the diameters and the A4 size. Friction: starting pull = μ(start) × weight, sliding pull = μ(slide) × weight; wood on wood 0.50 / 0.30 from S4, glass 0.25 / 0.20 and sandpaper 0.90 / 0.70 illustrative (no published value located). Roll: the car keeps 80 % of its energy down the ramp and slows at c g on the runway with c = 0.06, 0.09 and 0.25 for glass, wood and carpet: illustrative values, far larger than for a real toy car, so that every run fits on the bench; distance = 0.8 h ÷ c. Spring: illustrative, chosen inside the behaviour of S7; past 300 g the extension grows faster and a set remains. Brake: ω = 4π rad/s, I = 0.032 kg·m², pad friction coefficient 0.6 at a rim radius of 0.18 m, hub torque 0.005 N·m, pad force 0, 1 or 3 N: illustrative values for a wheel on a stand with no rider (S19 reports dry rim-brake coefficients of about 0.2–0.6 in one test series); stop time = I ω ÷ torque [S29]. The order of the surfaces, the equal fall of the balls and the doubling with height are the model's points; the sizes of the rolling and braking numbers are not. The big ball is 38 mm of steel at 7.8 g/cm³ (224 g, S26); the model uses 224 g for the 8 : 1 ratio with the 28 g ball. Each run gives the same number every time; real experiments are repeated. / 不是实测值。六个小型确定性模型（每个实验一个）给出 SIM 读数，全程按完整精度计算，只在显示时四舍五入。推：在推点给小车一个速度变化，之后在玻璃上以 0.06 g 减速。下落：dv/dt = g − (½ ρ C A ÷ m) v²，每毫秒算一步，ρ = 1.21 kg/m³，钢球 C = 0.45 [S6]，摊平的纸 1.12（借用圆形平板的值，示意），纸团 0.6（示意）；面积由直径和 A4 尺寸算出。摩擦：开始滑动的拉力 = μ（静）× 重量，保持滑动的拉力 = μ（动）× 重量；木对木 0.50 / 0.30 取自 S4，玻璃 0.25 / 0.20、砂纸 0.90 / 0.70 为示意值（未找到公开数据）。滚动：小车滑下斜面保留 80 % 的能量，在跑道上以 c g 减速，玻璃、木、地毯的 c 分别取 0.06、0.09、0.25：这些示意值比真实玩具车大得多，为的是让每一次都能在台上跑完；距离 = 0.8 h ÷ c。弹簧：示意值，落在 S7 所述的规律之内；超过 300 g 伸长加快，并留下永久伸长。刹车：ω = 4π rad/s，I = 0.032 kg·m²，刹车块摩擦系数 0.6，轮圈半径 0.18 m，轴上力矩 0.005 N·m，刹车块压力 0、1、3 N：架子上、无人骑的轮子的示意值（S19 一组试验中，干燥轮圈刹车的系数约 0.2–0.6）；停下用时 = I ω ÷ 力矩 [S29]。模型要说明的是：表面的先后顺序、轻重钢球同时落地、高度加倍距离加倍；滚动和刹车数字的大小不是重点。大钢球是直径 38 mm、密度 7.8 g/cm³ 的钢（224 g，S26），与 28 g 的小钢球正好 8 : 1。模型每次给出同样的数；真实实验要重复几次。)
- [S2] Ministry of Education Singapore, Curriculum Planning and Development Division, Science Teaching & Learning Syllabus, Primary Three to Six, Standard/Foundation (from the 2023 Primary Three cohort, updated January 2026). Printed pp. 63–64, Interaction of Forces (frictional force, gravitational force, elastic spring force), P6 Standard: identify a force as a push or a pull; a force can move a stationary object, speed up, slow down or change the direction of motion, stop a moving object, and may change the shape of an object; magnetic, gravitational, elastic spring and frictional force; investigate the effect of frictional force on motion and the effects of elastic spring force; objects have weight because of the gravitational force acting on them. Notes: the direction of frictional force on rolling objects and the terms 'air resistance' and 'water resistance' are not required. Printed pp. 15–17: design a fair test; analyse tables, bar and line graphs. / 新加坡教育部课程规划与发展司《小学三至六年级科学教学大纲》（标准／基础，2023 年小三起实施，2026 年 1 月更新）。印刷页第 63–64 页“力的相互作用（摩擦力、重力、弹簧的弹力）”，小六标准课程：认识力是推或拉；力能使静止的物体运动，使运动加快、减慢或改变方向，使运动的物体停下，也可能改变物体的形状；磁力、重力、弹簧的弹力和摩擦力；探究摩擦力对运动的影响、弹簧弹力的作用；物体有重量是因为重力作用在它身上。注释：不要求滚动物体所受摩擦力的方向，不要求“空气阻力”“水的阻力”这类名词。印刷页第 15–17 页：设计公平测试；分析表格、条形图和折线图。 (Read 2026-10-18 from the official PDF; printed page numbers (PDF page = printed page + 1). The learning outcomes contain no newtons, formulas or calculations; readings in newtons on this bench follow the spring balances, which are scaled in newtons. / 2026-10-18 读取官方 PDF；页码为印刷页码（PDF 页 = 印刷页 + 1）。学习结果里没有牛顿、公式或计算；本实验台用牛顿读数，是因为弹簧秤本来就以牛顿为刻度。) — https://www.moe.gov.sg/api/media/ba3562d3-5b31-4459-8693-45cde7b97273/Primary-Science-Syllabus-2023_May24.pdf

- [S4] OpenStax, College Physics 2e, §5.1 Friction: friction is proportional to the normal force (how hard the surfaces press together), not to the area in contact; the largest static friction is greater than kinetic friction for a given pair of surfaces. Table 5.1: wood on wood, static 0.5 and kinetic 0.3; shoes on wood 0.9 and 0.7; shoes on ice 0.1 and 0.05. / OpenStax《大学物理》第 2 版 §5.1“摩擦”：摩擦力与正压力（两个表面压得多紧）成正比，与接触面积无关；同一对表面，最大静摩擦力大于动摩擦力。表 5.1：木对木，静 0.5、动 0.3；鞋对木地板 0.9、0.7；鞋对冰 0.1、0.05。 (Read 2026-10-18. Values are approximate and depend on the surfaces' condition. The comparison is between the pull needed to start sliding (the largest static friction) and the pull to keep sliding; static friction can be any size up to that largest value. The block on this bench presses with its own weight because the lane is level. / 2026-10-18 读取。数值是近似值，会随表面状况变化。比较的是开始滑动所需的拉力（最大静摩擦力）和保持滑动所需的拉力；静摩擦力在这个最大值以内可以是任何大小。因为道面水平，木块压在道上的力就是它的重量。) — https://openstax.org/books/college-physics-2e/pages/5-1-friction

## How the sources were used

- **Facts audit.** Every number and claim in docs/30 §2 was checked against its source on 2026-10-18 (86 rows: 58 confirmed, 16 corrected, 12 that no source could settle). The corrections are applied in the chapters and in S1: the starting pull is compared with the sliding pull for this block (the largest static friction, not every static friction); friction grows with how hard the surfaces press together, not with "pressure"; the roughness order is said only for these surfaces; the side push is chosen to turn the car without changing its speed; the big ball is 224 g, eight times the 28 g ball at the density of steel; the brake times use the starting speed in radians per second; and fall times land between steps of the integration (as S1 describes), which gives 0.45 / 0.46 / 1.00 s at 1.0 m.
- **Illustrative values.** Where no published value exists for this apparatus, S1 says so and the chapters call the value illustrative: wood on glass and wood on sandpaper, the rolling values of the runway surfaces, the drag of the flat and crumpled paper, the test spring's stiffness, limit and set, and the brake wheel's inertia, pad force and hub friction. Their order or their pattern is the point, not their size.
- **Not used.** The National Institute of Standards and Technology page for 9.80665 m/s² named in docs/30 returned a malformed request; S8 (BIPM) is used instead. No explanatory page from the Building and Construction Authority on lift ropes and counterweights was found, so the lift note relies on a manufacturer's general description (S21) and says nothing about balance ratios. The PSLE syllabus (SEAB) returned an error page, so nothing here depends on it. R. Driver and others, Making Sense of Secondary Science (1994), could not be read and is not cited. The 1638 Galileo passage was not read and is not quoted. IOP Spark's "Clement 1983" digest is a different paper from S14 and is not cited.
- **Lower secondary.** S22 is cited only for "measure force in newtons" and "compare mass and weight"; it does not name Hooke's law or a weight formula, so the chapters only say these ideas come again in later science.
- **Chinese terms.** 力、推力、拉力、静止、运动、重力（地心引力）、重量、质量、摩擦力、表面、弹簧的弹力、伸长、磁力、弹簧秤、牛顿、公平测试 follow the usage of Singapore Chinese-language science materials as far as it could be checked; no official MOE Chinese glossary for this topic was found, so this is editorial terminology.
- **Reference images.** The apparatus is modelled from the Tier-1 descriptions in docs/30 §3.3 (common school equipment); no reference photographs were downloaded for this build, and none are published.
